lead: Build a rocket from real engines and see how far it can go: to orbit, to the Moon, or to Mars.
try: Pick a ready-made rocket at the top, like Saturn V or LVM3, and press launch. Then swap one engine and see what changes.
points: A rocket is mostly fuel: to go further you need far more fuel, not just a little more.
Engines that throw their exhaust out faster save fuel, which is why hydrogen engines are used for the top stages.
Rockets drop empty stages on the way up so they carry less dead weight.
